Name: EventView
Author: glopmtsyt
Description:
This mod adds a practical feature to [b]Stardew Valley[/b]: by pressing a configured key, an interactive in-game calendar opens.
[list]
[*]Default key: [b]"L"[/b]
[*]Can be accessed [b]anywhere in the game[/b]
[/list]✨ Features[list]
[*]Full monthly calendar view
[*]Shows [b]days and important events[/b] (festivals, birthdays, etc.)
[*]Quick access without needing to visit the town board
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Calendar Mod
Manifest.Description: Mostra o calendário com datas comemorativas ao pressionar uma tecla
Manifest.Author: GlopMts
